faults.name: Over-current at constant speed
faults.meaning: Output current went above the safe limit while the drive was running at steady speed (short circuit, locked rotor or heavy load). Output is switched off.
checks: Look for a shorted motor lead or phase-to-phase / phase-to-earth fault: disconnect the motor and megger the cable and motor windings
Check that the motor shaft turns freely and the load is not jammed or overloaded
On a dual-voltage motor, confirm the star/delta link arrangement matches the supply voltage

faults.name: Over-current during deceleration
faults.meaning: Excess output current was detected while slowing down; output is cut. The manual gives the same cause hints as E01.
checks: Look for a shorted motor lead or phase-to-phase / phase-to-earth fault: disconnect the motor and megger the cable and motor windings
Check that the motor shaft turns freely and the load is not jammed or overloaded
On a dual-voltage motor, confirm the star/delta link arrangement matches the supply voltage
Lengthen the deceleration time (F003 / A093) if the load inertia is high

faults.name: Over-current during acceleration
faults.meaning: Excess output current was detected while speeding up; output is cut. Same cause hints as E01.
checks: Look for a shorted motor lead or phase-to-phase / phase-to-earth fault: disconnect the motor and megger the cable and motor windings
Check that the motor shaft turns freely and the load is not jammed or overloaded
On a dual-voltage motor, confirm the star/delta link arrangement matches the supply voltage
Lengthen the acceleration time (F002 / A092) or review torque boost (A042) and V/f settings

faults.name: Over-current in other conditions
faults.meaning: Over-current occurred at a time that is not constant speed, acceleration or deceleration. Same cause hints as E01.
checks: Look for a shorted motor lead or phase-to-phase / phase-to-earth fault: disconnect the motor and megger the cable and motor windings
Check that the motor shaft turns freely and the load is not jammed or overloaded
On a dual-voltage motor, confirm the star/delta link arrangement matches the supply voltage

faults.name: Motor overload (electronic thermal)
faults.meaning: The drive's electronic thermal model decided the motor was overloaded and tripped the output.
checks: Check mechanical load and look for binding or a blocked fan/process
Verify the thermal level b012 matches the motor nameplate current and the characteristic b013 suits the motor
Check motor capacity H003 and pole count H004 are entered correctly

faults.name: Braking resistor overload
faults.meaning: The braking-chopper duty ratio went above the limit set in b090, so the drive shut off its output.
checks: Check b090 against the resistor's rating
Reduce regeneration: lengthen the deceleration time or use a larger / additional braking resistor
Check b097 resistor value setting is correct

faults.name: Over-voltage
faults.meaning: The DC bus voltage rose above its limit, for example from regenerative energy from the motor or a high supply voltage.
checks: Lengthen the deceleration time or enable deceleration over-voltage suppression (b130)
Fit or check a braking resistor / unit for overhauling loads
Measure the incoming supply voltage for surges or an over-high level

faults.name: EEPROM error
faults.meaning: The built-in memory had a problem, typically due to noise or high temperature, and the output was shut off.
checks: Cycle power; resets from RS terminal or STOP/RESET are not accepted for this trip
If it repeats, initialise the drive (b084 / b180) and re-enter settings
Review earthing, cable routing and cabinet temperature for noise/heat

faults.name: Under-voltage
faults.meaning: The internal DC bus voltage dropped under its threshold, which can cause control faults, motor heating or weak torque. The drive shuts off its output.
checks: Measure the supply voltage on all phases and look for dips or a missing phase
Check input contactor, fuses, terminals and any input reactor
See restart-after-undervoltage settings b001 to b005

faults.name: Current detection error
faults.meaning: A fault in the drive's internal current sensing circuit was detected and the output was shut off.
checks: Cycle power and retry
Check for heavy noise sources or earthing problems
If it persists the drive likely needs repair

faults.name: CPU error
faults.meaning: The drive's processor malfunctioned and the output was switched off.
checks: Cycle power and retry
Check earthing and noise suppression
If it repeats, have the drive repaired or replaced

faults.name: External trip
faults.meaning: A digital input assigned to the EXT function (option 12) was activated, so the drive latched a trip.
checks: Find which input is set to EXT in C001-C007 and check what is wired to it
Check the external device or interlock contact that triggered it
Check input logic (C011-C017) in case of an NO/NC mismatch

faults.name: Unattended start protection (USP)
faults.meaning: Power was applied while a run command was already active and USP was enabled, so the drive refused to start.
checks: Remove the run command (FW/RV) and then reset, or press reset
Wait at least 3 seconds after power-up before giving a run command
Disable the USP input if automatic start on power-up is wanted

faults.name: Ground fault
faults.meaning: A ground fault between the drive output and the motor was found during the power-up test. This protects the drive, not people.
checks: Disconnect the motor and insulation-test the motor and cable to earth
Check for moisture or damaged cable insulation
Reset is not accepted; cycle power, and initialise if the fault persists

faults.name: Input over-voltage
faults.meaning: The drive checks incoming voltage after 100 seconds in stop mode and tripped because the level was too high.
checks: Measure the supply voltage and compare with the drive's rating
Check for surges from other equipment or power factor correction caps
After clearing, the drive can run again

faults.name: Inverter thermal sensor error
faults.meaning: The thermal sensor inside the power module is not connected / not being read.
checks: Cycle power and retry
If persistent the drive hardware needs repair

faults.name: Inverter over-temperature
faults.meaning: The temperature of the power devices went above the allowed level, so the drive tripped.
checks: Check the cooling fan runs and the heatsink and vents are clean
Check cabinet and ambient temperature (b075) and clearances
Reduce load or carrier frequency (b083); check automatic carrier reduction b089

faults.name: CPU communication error
faults.meaning: Communication between the drive's two processors failed.
checks: Cycle power and retry
Check earthing and noise
Repair or replace if it recurs

faults.name: Main circuit error
faults.meaning: The drive could not confirm that its main power supply circuit was established, because of noise or a damaged main-circuit part.
checks: Cycle power; check the main power connection and fuses
Check for noise sources and earthing
Repair if it persists

faults.name: Driver error
faults.meaning: A fault in the safety protection circuit between the CPU and the output driver was detected, possibly from heavy electrical noise. The output stage was turned off.
checks: Reset by key/terminal is not accepted; cycle power
Improve earthing, shielding and cable separation to reduce noise
Initialise the drive if it recurs, then repair if still present

faults.name: Thermistor trip
faults.meaning: The motor thermistor connected to terminals 5 and L indicated an over-temperature, so the output was turned off.
checks: Check the motor temperature, ventilation and load
Check the thermistor wiring and the PTC function setting on terminal 5 (C005 = 19)
Check the thermistor calibration C085

faults.name: Brake error
faults.meaning: With brake control enabled (b120 = 01) the drive did not receive the brake confirmation signal within the confirmation wait time b124 after sending brake release.
checks: Check the brake confirmation (BOK) input wiring and the brake itself
Check b121-b127 timing and release settings
Check the brake actually lifts

faults.name: Safe stop
faults.meaning: The safe-stop (GS) input was triggered when b145 is set to 01.
checks: Check the safety circuit wired to GS1 and GS2 and the emergency stop device
The STOP/RESET key cannot reset it; cycle power
Initialise if the same trip returns

faults.name: Low-speed overload
faults.meaning: The drive detected an overload while running at very low speed and shut off the output.
checks: Check the load and motor at low speed for binding
Check the motor cooling at low speed
Review overload settings (b012, b021-b023)

faults.name: Operator connection error
faults.meaning: Communication between the drive and its keypad/operator failed.
checks: Check the operator cable and connector seating
Check the keypad for damage
See external operator loss action b165

faults.name: Modbus communication error
faults.meaning: A Modbus timeout occurred while the communication error action was set to trip (C076 = 00).
checks: Check the RS-485 wiring, termination and polarity
Check master polling interval against timeout C077
Check C071-C075 communication settings and C072 address match the master

faults.name: EzSQ invalid instruction
faults.meaning: The stored EzSQ program is corrupt, or the PRG input was turned on when no program was downloaded.
checks: Re-download the EzSQ program
Check the PRG terminal function and A017 setting if no program is used

faults.name: EzSQ nesting count error
faults.meaning: In the EzSQ program, subroutines, if-statements or for-next loops are nested deeper than eight levels.
checks: Simplify the program structure to eight levels or fewer and re-download

faults.name: EzSQ instruction error
faults.meaning: The drive met a program instruction it cannot execute.
checks: Review the EzSQ program for unsupported or invalid instructions and re-download

faults.name: EzSQ user trip 0 to 9
faults.meaning: User-defined trips raised by the EzSQ program (E50 to E59 correspond to user trip 0 to 9).
checks: Check the EzSQ program source to see which condition raises the trip

faults.name: Option board error
faults.meaning: The drive detected an error in the option board fitted in the option slot.
checks: Reseat the option board and check it is compatible
See the option board's instruction manual for the specific code
Check P001 for the action on option errors

faults.name: Encoder disconnection
faults.meaning: An encoder connection error was found: broken wiring, failed encoder, or an encoder that does not support line driver output.
checks: Check encoder wiring and shield
Check the encoder type and supply
Check P003, P004 and P011 settings

faults.name: Excessive speed
faults.meaning: Motor speed reached or exceeded the maximum frequency (A004) multiplied by the over-speed detection level (P026).
checks: Check encoder feedback and settings
Review A004 and P026
Check for an overhauling load

faults.name: Positioning range error
faults.meaning: The current position went outside the allowed position range set by P072 and P073.
checks: Review P072/P073 limits and the positioning set-up

faults.name: Outside failure (safe stop)
faults.meaning: Raised from the safe stop signal when b145 = 02 (outside failure).
checks: Check GS1, GS2 and EDM wiring and the external safety device
Reset by terminal/key is not accepted; cycle power

faults.name: Inside failure (safe stop)
faults.meaning: Raised from the safe stop signal when b145 = 02, 03 or 05 (inside failure).
checks: Check GS1, GS2 and EDM wiring and the external safety device
Reset by terminal/key is not accepted; cycle power

params.name: Output frequency monitor
params.desc: Live frequency the drive is sending to the motor. Handy for checking the drive is following the command.

params.name: Output current monitor
params.desc: Filtered motor current; compare with nameplate to spot overload or no-load conditions.

params.name: Rotation direction monitor
params.desc: Shows forward, stop or reverse.

params.name: PID feedback (PV) monitor
params.desc: Scaled process variable used by the PID loop (scaled by A075).

params.name: Intelligent input terminal status
params.desc: Shows which of the programmable input terminals are currently ON; useful for checking wiring.

params.name: Intelligent output terminal status
params.desc: Shows which programmable output terminals and relay are ON.

params.name: Output voltage monitor
params.desc: Voltage being applied to the motor.

params.name: Elapsed RUN time monitor
params.desc: Total hours the drive has been in run mode.

params.name: Elapsed power-on time monitor
params.desc: Total hours the drive has been powered.

params.name: Heat sink temperature monitor
params.desc: Cooling fin temperature; check this when diagnosing E21 over-temperature trips.

params.name: Life check monitor
params.desc: Indicates whether the electrolytic capacitors or the cooling fan have reached their life limit.

params.name: Dual monitor
params.desc: Shows two chosen d-monitors, switched with the up/down keys.

params.name: Inverter mode monitor
params.desc: Shows the active drive mode: induction CT, induction VT, high-frequency, or permanent magnet.

params.name: Frequency source monitor
params.desc: Shows where the frequency reference is currently coming from (operator, multi-speed, Modbus, analog input, etc.). Available from version 3.0.

params.name: Run command source monitor
params.desc: Shows the active run command source: terminal, operator, Modbus or option. Available from version 3.0.

params.name: Trip counter
params.desc: Number of trips recorded since the history was last cleared.

params.name: Trip monitor 1 (latest)
params.desc: Detail of the most recent trip: code, frequency, current, DC bus voltage and run/power-on hours at that moment. d082-d086 hold the five earlier trips.

params.name: Warning monitor
params.desc: Displays the active warning code.

params.name: DC bus voltage monitor
params.desc: Internal DC bus voltage; useful for over-/under-voltage diagnosis.

params.name: BRD load ratio monitor
params.desc: How heavily the built-in brake chopper is being used.

params.name: Electronic thermal monitor
params.desc: Accumulated motor thermal load; an E05 trip is expected as this approaches full. Available from version 3.0.

params.name: Output frequency setting
params.desc: Target frequency used when the frequency source is set to the keypad value (A001 = 02).

params.name: Acceleration time (1)
params.desc: Ramp-up time of the standard (first) acceleration profile.

params.name: Acceleration time (1), 2nd motor
params.desc: Same as F002 but applied when the second motor set is selected.

params.name: Deceleration time (1)
params.desc: Ramp-down time of the standard (first) deceleration profile. Lengthen it to cure over-voltage trips.

params.name: Deceleration time (1), 2nd motor
params.desc: Second-motor version of F003.

params.name: Keypad RUN key direction
params.desc: Chooses which direction the RUN key on the keypad commands.

params.name: Frequency source
params.range: 00 POT, 01 Terminal, 02 F001, 03 Modbus, 04 Option, 06 Pulse train, 07 EzSQ, 10 Calculate
params.desc: Selects where the speed reference comes from. If the drive ignores the keypad or analog input, check this first.

params.name: Frequency source, 2nd motor
params.desc: Second-motor version of A001.

params.name: Run command source
params.desc: Selects where start/stop commands come from. A drive that will not start from the keypad usually has this set to terminal.

params.name: Run command source, 2nd motor
params.desc: Second-motor version of A002.

params.name: Base frequency
params.desc: Frequency at which the output reaches full voltage; set to match the motor nameplate.

params.name: Base frequency, 2nd motor
params.desc: Second-motor version of A003.

params.name: Maximum frequency
params.desc: Upper limit of the output frequency for the V/f pattern and reference scaling.

params.name: Maximum frequency, 2nd motor
params.desc: Second-motor version of A004.

params.name: [AT] selection
params.desc: Defines which analog inputs the AT terminal switches between (O/OI, O/POT or OI/POT).

params.name: [O] input start frequency
params.desc: Frequency corresponding to the bottom of the 0-10 V analog input range.

params.name: [O] input end frequency
params.desc: Frequency corresponding to the top of the 0-10 V input range.

params.name: [O] input start voltage
params.desc: Percentage of the voltage input at which the active range begins.

params.name: [O] input end voltage
params.desc: Percentage of the voltage input at which the active range ends.

params.name: [O] start frequency enable
params.desc: Chooses whether the output at the minimum analog signal is the A011 offset or 0 Hz.

params.name: Analog input filter
params.desc: Smoothing filter for analog inputs; higher values calm a noisy reference but respond slower.

params.name: Multi-speed operation selection
params.desc: Chooses binary (16 speeds from 4 terminals) or bit-wise (8 speeds) multi-speed selection.

params.name: Multi-speed frequency 0
params.desc: First preset speed. Presets 1-15 are A021 to A035.

params.name: Multi-speed frequency 1 to 15
params.desc: Fifteen further preset speeds selected by the CF terminals.

params.name: Jog frequency
params.desc: Speed used for jogging.

params.name: Jog stop mode
params.desc: How the motor stops at the end of a jog (free-run, controlled decel or DC brake, with or without operation during run).

params.name: Torque boost select
params.desc: Chooses fixed or automatic low-speed torque boost.

params.name: Manual torque boost value
params.desc: Extra voltage at low speed to help starting; too much can cause over-current trips.

params.name: Manual torque boost frequency
params.desc: Frequency point (as a percentage of base) at which the manual boost ends.

params.name: V/f characteristic curve
params.range: 00 Constant torque, 01 Reduced torque, 02 Free V/f, 03 SLV
params.desc: Selects the voltage/frequency pattern or sensorless vector control.

params.name: V/f gain
params.desc: Scales the output voltage of the chosen V/f pattern.

params.name: DC braking enable
params.desc: Turns on DC injection braking at stop.

params.name: DC braking frequency
params.desc: Frequency below which DC braking begins.

params.name: DC braking wait time
params.desc: Delay between end of deceleration and start of DC braking.

params.name: DC braking force (decel)
params.desc: Strength of the DC braking current.

params.name: DC braking time (decel)
params.desc: How long DC braking is applied.

params.name: DC braking edge/level detect for [DB]
params.desc: Whether the DB terminal acts on a level or on an edge.

params.name: DC braking force at start
params.desc: DC braking level applied before starting to hold the shaft.

params.name: DC braking time at start
params.desc: Duration of the start-time DC braking.

params.name: Carrier frequency during DC braking
params.desc: PWM carrier used while DC braking (manual lists the unit as s; range implies kHz).

params.name: Frequency upper limit
params.desc: Caps the output below the maximum frequency.

params.name: Frequency lower limit
params.desc: Minimum frequency the drive will run at once started.

params.name: Jump frequency 1 (center)
params.desc: Centre of a frequency band the drive skips to avoid mechanical resonance. A065 and A067 are jumps 2 and 3.

params.name: Jump frequency 1 width
params.desc: Half-width of jump band 1. A066 and A068 are widths 2 and 3.

params.name: Acceleration hold frequency
params.desc: Frequency at which acceleration pauses.

params.name: Acceleration hold time
params.desc: Duration of the acceleration pause.

params.name: PID enable
params.desc: Turns on the built-in PID controller.

params.name: PID proportional gain
params.desc: Proportional gain of the PID loop.

params.name: PID integral time
params.desc: Integral time constant.

params.name: PID derivative time
params.desc: Derivative time constant.

params.name: PV scale conversion
params.desc: Multiplier applied to the feedback value for display.

params.name: PV source
params.desc: Chooses the feedback signal for PID.

params.name: Reverse PID action
params.desc: Inverts the error sign for processes where more output lowers the feedback.

params.name: PID output limit
params.desc: Limits how much the PID output can correct the frequency.

params.name: AVR function select
params.desc: Automatic voltage regulation keeps motor voltage steady when supply varies.

params.name: AVR voltage select
params.desc: Rated motor voltage for AVR; set from the motor nameplate.

params.name: Energy-saving operation mode
params.desc: Reduces output voltage under light load to save energy.

params.name: Acceleration time (2)
params.desc: Second acceleration ramp time.

params.name: Deceleration time (2)
params.desc: Second deceleration ramp time.

params.name: Method to switch to Acc2/Dec2
params.desc: Chooses what triggers the second ramp set.

params.name: Acc1 to Acc2 transition frequency
params.desc: Frequency at which acceleration changes to the second ramp.

params.name: Dec1 to Dec2 transition frequency
params.desc: Frequency at which deceleration changes to the second ramp.

params.name: Acceleration curve selection
params.desc: Ramp shape for acceleration: linear, S, U, inverse U or EL-S.

params.name: Deceleration curve selection
params.desc: Ramp shape for deceleration.

params.name: [OI] input start frequency
params.desc: Frequency at the bottom of the 4-20 mA input range.

params.name: [OI] input end frequency
params.desc: Frequency at the top of the current input range.

params.name: [OI] input start current
params.desc: Percentage of full-scale current at which the active range starts (20% = 4 mA).

params.name: [OI] input end current
params.desc: Percentage of full-scale current at which the active range ends.

params.name: [OI] start frequency select
params.desc: Whether output at minimum signal is A101 or 0 Hz.

params.name: A input select (calculate function)
params.desc: First operand source for the calculate function.

params.name: B input select (calculate function)
params.desc: Second operand source for the calculate function.

params.name: Calculation symbol
params.desc: Operation applied to A and B inputs.

params.name: ADD frequency
params.desc: Offset added to or subtracted from the output frequency when the ADD terminal is on.

params.name: Restart mode on power failure / under-voltage
params.desc: Selects whether and how the drive restarts after a power dip.

params.name: Allowable under-voltage power failure time
params.desc: How long an under-voltage can last before the drive trips regardless of restart mode.

params.name: Retry wait time before motor restart
params.desc: Delay after power returns before the motor restarts.

params.name: Power failure / under-voltage trip alarm enable
params.desc: Whether a brief power failure raises a trip alarm.

params.name: Number of restarts on power failure
params.desc: Limits automatic restarts after under-voltage.

params.name: Restart mode on over-voltage / over-current trip
params.desc: Automatic restart behaviour after OC/OV trips.

params.name: Number of retries on OV/OC trip
params.desc: Maximum automatic retries after over-voltage/over-current trips.

params.name: Retry wait time on OV/OC trip
params.desc: Wait before each retry.

params.name: Level of electronic thermal
params.desc: Motor overload trip level; set to the motor nameplate current to protect the motor (E05).

params.name: Electronic thermal characteristic
params.desc: Selects the thermal curve matching the motor type and cooling.

params.name: Free thermal frequency 1
params.desc: First frequency point for the free-setting thermal curve (b017, b019 are points 2 and 3; b016, b018, b020 are the currents).

params.name: Overload restriction operation mode
params.desc: Limits current during overload by adjusting frequency instead of tripping.

params.name: Overload restriction level
params.desc: Current level at which overload restriction acts.

params.name: Deceleration rate at overload restriction
params.desc: How fast frequency is reduced during overload restriction.

params.name: OC suppression selection
params.range: 00 Off, 01 On, 02 On with voltage reduction
params.desc: Suppresses over-current trips by easing the output.

params.name: Software lock mode selection
params.desc: Locks parameters against changes. If a value will not change, check this and the SFT terminal.

params.name: Motor cable length parameter
params.desc: Cable length compensation setting.

params.name: Run / power-on warning time
params.desc: Time after which a run-time warning is raised; 0 disables.

params.name: Rotation direction restriction
params.desc: Blocks one direction of rotation.

params.name: Reduced voltage start selection
params.desc: Softens the voltage ramp at start; 0 disables.

params.name: Function code display restriction
params.desc: Restricts which parameters are visible; if a parameter seems missing set 00 for full display.

params.name: Initial display selection
params.desc: Chooses the parameter shown on power-up.

params.name: Torque limit selection
params.desc: Chooses how torque limits are set (by quadrant, terminals or analog).

params.name: Torque limit 1 (fwd/power)
params.desc: Torque limit in the forward driving quadrant (b042-b044 cover the other quadrants).

params.name: Reverse run protection
params.desc: Prevents unintended reverse rotation.

params.name: Dual rating selection
params.desc: Selects constant-torque or variable-torque drive rating.

params.name: Controlled deceleration on power loss
params.desc: What the drive does when mains is lost: trip or ride through by decelerating.

params.name: Operation level at [O] disconnection
params.desc: Reference level the drive uses if the voltage analog signal is lost.

params.name: Operation level at [OI] disconnection
params.desc: Reference level used if the 4-20 mA signal is lost.

params.name: Ambient temperature setting
params.desc: Ambient temperature used for derating decisions.

params.name: Watt-hour clearance
params.desc: Clears the watt-hour counter.

params.name: Start frequency
params.desc: Frequency at which output starts when a run command is given.

params.name: Carrier frequency
params.desc: PWM switching frequency; lower it to cut noise and heating, raise it for quieter motor.

params.name: Initialization mode
params.desc: Chooses what is reset: trip history, parameters, or both (and the EzSQ program).

params.name: Country for initialization
params.desc: Regional default set used on initialization.

params.name: Frequency scaling conversion factor
params.desc: Multiplier for the scaled frequency display d007.

params.name: STOP key enable
params.range: 00 On, 01 Always off, 02 Off for stop
params.desc: Whether the keypad STOP key works.

params.name: Restart mode after FRS
params.desc: How the drive resumes after a free-run stop is cancelled.

params.name: Automatic carrier frequency reduction
params.desc: Reduces carrier automatically as current or heatsink temperature rises.

params.name: Dynamic braking usage ratio
params.desc: Allowed duty of the braking resistor; 0 disables braking (E06 threshold).

params.name: Stop mode selection
params.desc: Whether a stop command ramps down or coasts.

params.name: Cooling fan control
params.desc: When the cooling fan runs.

params.name: Initialization target data
params.desc: Which parameter groups are reset on initialization.

params.name: Dynamic braking control (BRD) selection
params.desc: Enables the built-in brake chopper.

params.name: BRD activation level
params.desc: DC bus voltage at which braking turns on.

params.name: BRD resistor value
params.desc: Value of the connected braking resistor.

params.name: Brake control enable
params.desc: Enables the mechanical brake sequence.

params.name: Brake wait time for release
params.desc: Delay before the brake release signal.

params.name: Brake wait time for confirmation
params.desc: Time allowed for brake confirmation before an E36 trip.

params.name: Deceleration overvoltage suppression enable
params.desc: Prevents E07 trips by holding or extending deceleration when the DC bus rises.

params.name: Decel overvoltage suppression level
params.desc: DC bus level at which suppression acts.

params.name: GS input mode
params.desc: Selects how the safe stop (GS1/GS2) inputs behave and which trip codes they produce.

params.name: Display when external operator connected
params.desc: Parameter shown on the built-in display when an external operator is attached.

params.name: External operator communication loss action
params.desc: What the drive does if the external operator connection is lost.

params.name: Data read/write select
params.desc: Write protection for data.

params.name: Inverter mode selection
params.desc: Selects standard IM, high-frequency IM or PM motor mode. Initialise after changing.

params.name: Initialization trigger
params.desc: Setting 01 starts the initialization configured by b084, b085 and b094.

params.name: Password setting A
params.desc: Sets a password for parameter protection.

params.name: Password authentication A
params.desc: Entry used to unlock password A.

params.name: Input [1] function
params.desc: Assigns a function to digital input terminal 1; C002-C007 do the same for terminals 2-7.

params.name: Input [2] function
params.desc: Function of input terminal 2.

params.name: Input [3] function
params.desc: Function of input terminal 3 (can be GS1).

params.name: Input [4] function
params.desc: Function of input terminal 4 (can be GS2).

params.name: Input [5] function
params.desc: Function of input terminal 5 (can be PTC thermistor).

params.name: Input [6] function
params.desc: Function of input terminal 6.

params.name: Input [7] function
params.desc: Function of input terminal 7.

params.name: Input [1] active state
params.desc: Normally open or closed logic for input 1; C012-C017 cover inputs 2-7.

params.name: Output [11] function
params.desc: Function of open-collector output 11.

params.name: Output [12] function
params.desc: Function of open-collector output 12.

params.name: Alarm relay function
params.desc: Function of the relay output.

params.name: [EO] terminal selection
params.desc: Signal output on the pulse/PWM EO terminal.

params.name: [AM] terminal selection
params.desc: Signal output on the 0-10 V AM terminal.

params.name: Output [11] active state
params.desc: Contact logic of output 11.

params.name: Output [12] active state
params.desc: Contact logic of output 12.

params.name: Alarm relay active state
params.desc: Relay logic; default NC means the relay also signals power loss.

params.name: Low current detection level
params.desc: Threshold for the low-load output.

params.name: Overload warning level
params.desc: Current at which the OL output turns on, before an overload trip.

params.name: Frequency arrival setting for acceleration
params.desc: Threshold for the FA2/FA3 outputs during acceleration.

params.name: Frequency arrival setting for deceleration
params.desc: Threshold for the FA2/FA3 outputs during deceleration.

params.name: Electronic thermal warning level
params.desc: Thermal load at which the THM warning output turns on.

params.name: Zero speed detection level
params.desc: Frequency below which the ZS output is on.

params.name: Heat sink overheat warning
params.desc: Heatsink temperature at which the OHF warning output turns on.

params.name: Communication speed
params.desc: Modbus baud rate (05 = 9600). Power cycle needed.

params.name: Modbus address
params.desc: Slave address of the drive on the network.

params.name: Communication parity
params.desc: Serial parity. Power cycle needed.

params.name: Communication stop bit
params.desc: Number of stop bits. Power cycle needed.

params.name: Communication error select
params.desc: Action on a communication error: trip, decelerate, ignore, coast or decelerate to stop (trip gives E41).

params.name: Communication error time-out
params.desc: Watchdog time before a communication loss is declared.

params.name: Communication wait time
params.desc: Delay before the drive replies to a Modbus request.

params.name: [O] input span calibration
params.desc: Fine scale adjustment of the voltage analog input.

params.name: [OI] input span calibration
params.desc: Fine scale adjustment of the current analog input.

params.name: Thermistor input span calibration
params.desc: Calibration for the PTC thermistor input.

params.name: Communication selection
params.desc: Serial protocol used on RS-485. Power cycle needed.

params.name: Up/Down memory mode selection
params.desc: Whether the UP/DWN adjusted frequency is remembered after power-off.

params.name: Reset selection
params.desc: Defines when the RS input clears a trip and whether it stops a running drive.

params.name: Restart mode after reset
params.desc: How the drive restarts after a reset.

params.name: Overload warning level 2
params.desc: Threshold for the second overload warning output (OL2).

params.name: Input [1] response time
params.desc: Debounce/response time of input 1; C161-C166 for inputs 2-6.

params.name: Auto-tuning selection
params.desc: Starts motor auto-tuning to measure motor constants.

params.name: Motor constant selection
params.desc: Chooses which motor data set the drive uses.

params.name: Motor capacity
params.desc: Motor power; set from the nameplate.

params.name: Motor poles setting
params.desc: Number of motor poles; set from nameplate.

params.name: Motor speed response constant
params.desc: Speed response gain for vector control.

params.name: Motor stabilization constant
params.desc: Stability adjustment; raise if the motor hunts.

params.name: Motor constant R1 (Hitachi motor)
params.desc: Primary resistance for standard Hitachi motor data; H021 R2, H022 L, H023 I0, H024 J follow.

params.name: Motor constant R1 (auto-tuned)
params.desc: Auto-tuned primary resistance; H031 R2, H032 L, H033 I0, H034 J follow.

params.name: PM motor code setting
params.desc: Selects PM motor data source.

params.name: PM motor capacity
params.desc: Rated power of the PM motor.

params.name: PM motor pole setting
params.desc: Number of poles of the PM motor.

params.name: PM rated current
params.desc: Rated current of the PM motor.

params.name: Reaction when option card error occurs
params.desc: Whether an option card fault trips the drive.

params.name: [EA] terminal selection
params.desc: Function of the EA input (speed reference, encoder feedback or EzSQ).

params.name: Pulse train input mode for feedback
params.desc: Encoder signal type.

params.name: Encoder pulse setting
params.desc: Encoder pulses per revolution.

params.name: Over-speed error detection level
params.desc: Level used for the E81 excessive speed trip.

params.name: Speed deviation error detection level
params.desc: Speed deviation threshold for DSE output.

params.name: Serial communication mode
params.desc: Select Modbus register mapping mode. Power cycle needed. Version 3.0 onwards.
